newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL rubber remains depressed at close on Thai baht.
newsitem.headline: KL rubber remains depressed at close on Thai baht.

text.p: Rubber prices extended their losses at the close, with expectations of further falls in other producing countries next week keeping buyers on the sidelines, dealers said.

"Sentiment will continue to remain depressed. Prices would fall further if regional prices remain weak," a broker said. "It looks like prices are likely to move nearer to the INRO's 'may-buy' level. Then we should see fresh intervention by the INRO buffer stock manager to prop up the market."
INRO five-day average was 192.43 Malaysian/Singapore cents a kg on July 3 from 194.66 on July 2. INRO's "may-buy" is 183.
